question: Does verdict dead fit crawler-scraper/searxng? The store defines dead as the offer or the service no longer existing, while searx.space lists 72 online public instances on 2026-11-01 that answer a scripted request with 429, 403, 418 or a challenge page; fails-egress (data cannot be read back out at a usable rate) or fails-quota may describe the refusal better.
why: The verdict decides which list the record appears in, and an offer that exists and refuses a plain scripted client is not the case that the dead term defines; choosing between the other verdicts is a judgement a verify unit should not make on its own.
